skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the fundamental theories of urban administrative management, including the organizational structure and operational mechanisms of administrative bodies.
Grasp the basic issues of urban public administration, understand the administrative structure from central to local levels, and comprehend the decision-making process and administrative procedures.
Apply theoretical knowledge to evaluate administrative decision-making processes and criteria for selecting and assessing civil servants.
Demonstrate the ability to work in groups, gather information, and analyze urban activities to prepare group presentations and future professional activities.
Develop social awareness and professional ethics, and prepare for future professional responsibilities.
Understand and manage legal documents and administrative procedures.
Analyze and evaluate issues related to urban public administration.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze urban management policies and practices.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on urban administrative topics.
Conduct independent research and gather information from various sources.
